general_notes: Candidate groups recurred in every state: (1) the painting with a thin border (near 10), (2) a heavily blurred copy, (3) a different 3D-rendered character, (4) in-app soft vignette versions, (5) in-app hard near-black versions with a more cut-out glow, (6) a tight zoomed crop cutting off legs. Several pairs looked identical to me (idle B/E and G/H; joyful C/H; fierce A/F; depleted C/F) and got identical scores; I could not resolve differences between them at this resolution. In-app versions lose the painted backdrop and environmental warm light by design, scored under P2-P4. The depleted target contains a grey rectangle at bottom right that appears to be in the source; its absence in in-app versions was not penalised. All animation sequences are very subtle (flicker of flame tips/embers only, no body motion); with only six frames I could not judge temporal smoothness or loop seam, so A1/A4 are judged from frame-to-frame differences only.
